grounding.framework: Abraham et al. (2019) data governance framework
grounding.citation: Abraham, R., Schneider, J., & vom Brocke, J. (2019). Data governance: A conceptual framework, structured review, and research agenda. International Journal of Information Management, 49, 424-438. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijinfomgt.2019.07.008
grounding.note: Lineage records the provenance chain for each signal: bronze source, any Silver intermediate, pipeline stages applied, and transformations. Non-transformed signals are traceable to their bronze source file with a full stage history.

run_context.note: This field is non-deterministic. Strip it for diffing.

pipeline_stages.description: Dataset profiling: per-participant, per-signal sample counts, sampling rates, and value ranges. Establishes the baseline against which later checks are cross-validated.
Format, numeric type, and physiological range conformance checks across all signals and participants.
Missingness and sequence-gap checks across all signals. Cross-validated against Task 2 baseline.

Physiological plausibility checks against supervisor-signed-off bounds (config/physiological_ranges.yaml, signed off Dr. Tobias Cibis 2026-09-09). RespiBAN chest EDA (CH2) and TEMP (CH4) are explicitly excluded from plausibility checking: they are stored as raw sensor values, not physical units, and their physiology is already verified on the E4 wrist channels (duplicate coverage). Deliberate scope decision, documented in docs/progress_log.md.

Cross-modal temporal alignment between E4 wristband and RespiBAN chest sensor. Five-point nearest-sample reconstruction measures the maximum absolute timestamp offset within the recording overlap window.

E4 TEMP warm-up artefact removal. Indices 0-3 of each participant's E4 TEMP channel replaced with NaN in the Silver layer (bronze untouched). Literal 'NaN' text preserves channel length regardless of pandas read settings. 60 samples replaced across 15 participants (4 per participant).

transformations.description: NTC thermistor warm-up artefact: sensor reads ~382 degrees C during the first second before reaching thermal equilibrium. Indices 0-3 replaced with NaN; channel length preserved.
